title: Economic analysis of off-bottom oyster culture
Mixed-mode surveys reveal shared regulatory preferences in an overfished recreational fishery
abstract: Population declines of spotted seatrout Cynoscion nebulosus have reached levels that warrant management action in Louisiana, USA waters. As regulatory adjustments are necessary to recover the stock, we evaluated the viability of recovery options while gathering preference data from respondents through three survey modes. The modes applied were: (1) a series of public scoping meetings, (2) a probability-based sample of fishing license-holders, and (3) an open-access online survey. Among survey modes, significant differences were seen in avidity, typical harvest, and perceptions of the fishery, indicating that we captured responses from three distinct user groups. Despite these differences, several common themes emerged among all three survey types. Respondents in all survey types indicated strong levels of support for regulations decreasing allowable harvest relative to regulations at the time of survey execution. Specifically, our study presents a viable recovery scenario while accounting for the preferences of multiple user groups.
abstract_zh: 美国路易斯安那州水域中斑海鳟（Cynoscion nebulosus）的种群数量下降，已达到需要采取管理行动的程度。由于需要进行监管调整以使种群恢复，我们在评估各种恢复方案可行性的同时，通过三种调查模式收集了受访者的偏好数据。这三种模式分别为：（1）一系列公开的征询会议；（2）基于概率抽样的渔业执照持有者样本；（3）开放获取的在线调查。在各调查模式之间，在热衷程度、典型捕捞量以及对渔业的认知方面存在显著差异，表明我们分别获得了三类不同用户群体的回应。尽管存在这些差异，三种调查类型中仍出现了若干共同主题。所有调查类型的受访者都表示强烈支持将允许捕捞量降低到调查实施时的规定水平之下。具体而言，本研究提出了一个可行的恢复方案，同时兼顾了多个用户群体的偏好。

title: Economic Values of Potential Regulation Changes for the Southern Flounder Fishery in Louisiana
abstract: Population declines of Southern Flounder Paralichthys lethostigma have reached levels that present management concerns in Louisiana waters. As the need for regulatory change in this fishery approaches, we conducted a survey to better characterize the Southern Flounder fishery in Louisiana, with two primary goals: (1) determining a value for the economic welfare provided by the fishery and (2) evaluating how this value might change in response to hypothetical regulation scenarios. Based on total travel cost estimates, the aggregate economic value of the Southern Flounder fishery among coastal Louisiana anglers reached an estimated US$119.7 million; however, this value primarily stems from anglers targeting multiple species during their coastal angling trips, as the value of the Southern Flounder fishery while only accounting for anglers that solely targeted this species amounted to an estimated $8.4 million. Respondents revealed strong levels of supportiveness for all regulation scenarios that increased limitations on allowable harvest for Southern Flounder. None of the hypothetical regulation scenarios led to significant behavioral responses in the expected number of coastal angling trips taken, leaving the economic value of coastal Louisiana fisheries unchanged. The results of our study illustrate the relatively inconsequential nature of Southern Flounder regulations upon the behavior of coastal Louisiana anglers. The information gathered by this survey can be used to guide the decision-making process in developing a sustainable management strategy that is supported by stakeholders and that keeps the strong economic values of coastal Louisiana fisheries intact.
abstract_zh: 南方大比目鱼（Paralichthys lethostigma）的种群数量下降，已在路易斯安那州水域引发管理方面的担忧。随着该渔业监管变革的需求逐渐临近，我们开展了一项调查，以更好地刻画路易斯安那州的南方大比目鱼渔业，主要有两个目标：（1）确定该渔业所提供经济福利的价值；（2）评估这一价值在假设监管情景下可能如何变化。基于总旅行成本估计，路易斯安那沿海垂钓者中南方大比目鱼渔业的总体经济价值估计达 1.197 亿美元；然而，这一价值主要来自在沿海垂钓旅行中同时捕捞多个物种的垂钓者，而仅考虑专门捕捞该物种的垂钓者时，南方大比目鱼渔业的价值估计为 840 万美元。受访者对所有增加南方大比目鱼捕捞限制的监管情景都表现出强烈的支持。假设的监管情景均未导致沿海垂钓出行次数出现显著的行为反应，因此路易斯安那沿海渔业的经济价值保持不变。本研究结果表明，南方大比目鱼的监管措施对路易斯安那沿海垂钓者的行为影响相对微小。本调查所收集的信息可用于指导制定可持续管理策略的决策过程，该策略应获得利益相关方的支持，并使路易斯安那沿海渔业的可观经济价值得以保持。

title: The economics of sediment quality on barrier shoreline restoration
Electronic Self-Reporting: Angler Attitudes and Behaviors in the Recreational Red Snapper Fishery
venue: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
abstract: Managing large multiuser fisheries involves large amounts of data and information, including information directly from anglers. Angler-provided information may come in the form of attitudinal and behavior surveys, in addition to voluntary reporting of catch information. In this study, we wanted to better understand anglers fishing for Red Snapper Lutjanus campechanus in the Gulf of Mexico. Toward this end, we conducted an in-season attitudinal survey in 2018 to collect angler opinions in five areas: (1). interests, motivations, and barriers to electronic catch reporting, (2). important aspects of the Red Snapper fishery, (3). reasons why anglers report catch, (4). dockside reporting compared with electronic reporting, and (5). perceptions of fishery management agencies. Concurrently in the summer of 2018, an electronic smartphone app was made available for recreational anglers to voluntarily report their catch. We had 3,016 survey results that represented an 18% reporting rate. The survey results suggested that 84% of respondents already use a variety of smartphone apps in relation to fishing and that at least 80% reported that they were willing to electronically report their catch. Despite this high reported willingness to electronically report their catch, data from electronic reports showed that only about 1% of respondents actually reported. The development and use of electronic reporting applications (i.e., smartphone apps) holds promise to provide a wide variety of timely data to fishery managers; however, as in our study and others, usage rates remain low and challenges remain if self-reporting and other nonprobabilistic sampling methods are to be useful to fishery managers.
abstract_zh: 管理规模庞大的多用户渔业需要大量数据和信息，其中包括来自垂钓者的信息。垂钓者提供的信息既可以是态度与行为调查，也可以是自愿报告的捕获信息。本研究旨在更好地了解在墨西哥湾捕捞红鲷（Lutjanus campechanus）的垂钓者。为此，我们于 2018 年开展了一项季节性态度调查，以收集垂钓者在五个方面的意见：（1）对电子渔获报告的兴趣、动机和障碍；（2）红鲷渔业的重要方面；（3）垂钓者报告渔获的原因；（4）码头报告与电子报告的比较；（5）对渔业管理机构的看法。同时，2018 年夏季，一款电子智能手机应用程序向休闲垂钓者开放，供其自愿报告渔获。我们共收到 3,016 份调查结果，报告率为 18%。调查结果显示，84% 的受访者已在使用各种与钓鱼相关的智能手机应用，至少 80% 的受访者表示愿意以电子方式报告渔获。尽管受访者表示有很高的电子报告意愿，但电子报告的数据显示，实际报告的受访者仅约占 1%。电子报告应用程序（即智能手机应用）的开发与应用，有望为渔业管理者提供大量及时的数据；然而，正如本研究及其他研究所示，使用率仍然较低，若要使自我报告及其他非概率抽样方法对渔业管理者有用，仍面临诸多挑战。

Trajectory economics: Assessing the flow of ecosystem services from coastal restoration
abstract: Monetized estimates of ecosystem services are increasingly cited as partial justification for a wide range of environmental restoration initiatives, yet parallel applications of these values in performance assessment have been limited. Incorporated into traditional economic models, such values can offer potential insight on programmatic efficiency and help to inform policy tradeoffs within and between competing methods. For this analysis, acreage trajectories and cost functions are developed for dredge- and diversion-based land reclamation methods in coastal Louisiana, USA. Benefit–cost models are constructed from which ecosystem service values are initially derived via break-even analysis and then specified to inform comparative case studies. Results indicate that the minimum service value required to offset project expenditures is typically higher for “natural” diversion-based restoration relative to “rapid” dredge-based methods under historic project conditions. Accounting for climatological and socioeconomic risks widens this gap, with benefit–cost ratios for dredge-based reclamation exceeding that of diversions in 16 benefit–cost simulations conducted over a 50-year project horizon. Taken together, these results highlight the influence of time and risk in the assessment of competing project alternatives, and suggest the need to reframe restoration efficiency in terms of the aggregate flow of ecosystem services, versus the per unit costs of terminal stocks.
abstract_zh: 生态系统服务的货币化估值越来越多地被用作各类环境修复举措的部分理据，然而这些价值在绩效评估中的应用仍然有限。将此类价值纳入传统经济模型，有助于深入理解项目效率，并为不同方法之间及其内部的政策权衡提供参考。本分析为路易斯安那州沿海地区基于挖泥和基于分流（diversion）的土地复垦方法，建立了面积演变轨迹与成本函数。我们构建了效益—成本模型，首先通过盈亏平衡分析推导生态系统服务价值，再将其具体化，用于比较案例研究。结果表明，在历史项目条件下，要抵消项目支出所需的最低服务价值，通常对于“自然”的分流式修复高于“快速”的挖泥式修复。若考虑气候和社会经济风险，这一差距会进一步扩大：在 50 年项目期限内进行的 16 次效益—成本模拟中，挖泥式复垦的效益—成本比超过了分流式。综合来看，这些结果凸显了时间和风险在评估相互竞争的项目方案中的影响，并表明有必要从生态系统服务的总体流量而非终端存量的单位成本角度，重新界定修复效率。

title: Determining the effect of environmental accidents on responses to a Gulf of Mexico recreational for‐hire fishing industry survey a
abstract:
A survey designed to collect economic, attitudinal and policy data from the recreational for‐hire (
RFH
) fishing industry in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico was conducted before and during the largest marine oil spill in U.S. history (the April 2010 Deepwater Horizon blowout). Respondents were grouped into two time periods based on when the survey was completed, where the break in groups was determined through the examination of the Pew Research Center's media coverage index and the per cent of fishing area closures due to the oil spill. A logistic regression was used to test variables that might predict the time period of a response. Results indicated that recall bias was not present in the financial variables examined, but that firm operating and demographic characteristics (
i.e
. vessel size, annual number of trips, number of vessels operating in the firm, tenure and household income) were significant in explaining the time period in which surveys were completed.
abstract_zh: 一项旨在收集墨西哥湾美国休闲租赁（recreational for-hire, RFH）捕鱼行业经济、态度及政策数据的调查，是在美国历史上最大规模的海上溢油事件——2010 年 4 月“深水地平线”（Deepwater Horizon）井喷事故——之前和期间进行的。根据皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）的媒体报道指数以及因溢油而关闭的捕鱼区域百分比，受访者被分为两个时间段，分组界限由此确定。本研究采用逻辑回归检验可能预测受访时间段的变量。结果表明，所考察的财务变量中不存在回忆偏差，但企业运营特征和人口特征（即船只规模、年度出航次数、企业拥有的船只数量、经营年限和家庭收入）在解释调查完成的时间段方面具有显著性。

Opening a Public Recreation Area to Revitalize Coastal Communities and Preserve Natural Resources in Louisiana: The Case of Elmer's Island
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: The income capitalization approach is used, based on expenditure and nonmarket values collected from travel-cost and contingent valuation methodologies, to measure the feasibility of running a self-sustaining recreational site in coastal Louisiana. Through Internet and intercept surveys, a total of 2,696 respondents, 88% of them anglers, provided information on economic expenditures, destination preferences, and preferences for specific site amenities regarding Elmer's Island. The purchase and subsequent opening of the area to the public were found to be self-sustaining even when considering conservative economic estimates.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用收入资本化法，基于旅行成本法和条件价值评估法收集的支出和非市场价值数据，衡量在路易斯安那州沿海地区经营一个自负盈亏的休闲场所的可行性。通过互联网和拦截式调查，共有 2,696 名受访者（其中 88% 为垂钓者）提供了关于经济支出、目的地偏好以及对埃尔默岛（Elmer's Island）特定场地设施偏好的信息。研究发现，即使考虑保守的经济估计，购买该区域并随后向公众开放，也能够实现自负盈亏。

title: A CASE FOR SUBVENTION OF PRIVATE LANDOWNERS IN THE LOUISIANA COASTAL ZONE
Developing Consensus Indicators of Sustainability for Southeastern United States Aquaculture
abstract: Many diverse, conflicting stakeholders groups are activeley engaged in an increasingly volatile debate over the proper definition and application of sustainability in aquaculture. Attempts to find common-ground on general sustainability goals and parameters have not yet been successful. This study illustrates the potential of utilizing a Delphi approach to identify and refine consensus indicators of sustainability along three separate disciplinary axes; environmental, economic, and sociological. In fact, nonparametric statistical analysis of sustainability categories and indicators indicated a high level of consensus among and between diverse stakeholder groups after the Delphi process.
abstract_zh: 许多观点各异、相互冲突的利益相关方群体，正积极参与一场日益激烈的争论，即如何正确界定和应用水产养殖中的可持续性概念。在可持续性的一般目标和参数上寻求共同点的尝试，迄今尚未成功。本研究展示了利用德尔菲法（Delphi approach）的潜力，即沿环境、经济和社会学三个不同学科维度，识别并完善可持续性的共识指标。事实上，对可持续性类别和指标进行的非参数统计分析表明，在德尔菲过程之后，不同利益相关方群体之间及群体内部达成了高度共识。
